meta.title: Advanced English Grammar and Usage Test

questions.question: Not until the rain stopped _______ we leave the shelter.
questions.explanation: Topic: Inversion with 'Not until'. When 'Not until' begins a sentence, the main clause requires subject-auxiliary inversion. | Topik: Inversion dengan 'Not until'. Ketika 'Not until' memulai kalimat, klausa utama memerlukan inversi subjek-kata kerja bantu.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The man which lives next door is a doctor.
questions.explanation: Topic: Relative Pronouns. 'Who' is used for people, while 'which' is exclusively used for animals or things. | Topik: Relative Pronouns. 'Who' digunakan untuk orang, sedangkan 'which' secara eksklusif digunakan untuk hewan atau benda.

questions.question: Rarely _______ such a brilliant performance.
questions.explanation: Topic: Negative Inversion. When a sentence begins with a negative or restrictive adverb (rarely, never, seldom), the subject and auxiliary verb are inverted. | Topik: Negative Inversion. Ketika kalimat dimulai dengan adverbia negatif atau restriktif (rarely, never, seldom), subjek dan kata kerja bantu dibalik posisinya.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Hardly had the meeting started when the fire alarm rings.
questions.explanation: Topic: Inversion with 'Hardly'. Structure: Hardly + had + subject + past participle + when + simple past. The sequence of tenses must be maintained. | Topik: Inversion dengan 'Hardly'. Struktur: Hardly + had + subjek + past participle + when + simple past. Urutan tenses harus dipertahankan.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: This is the most unique painting in the gallery.
questions.explanation: Topic: Absolute Adjectives. Words like 'unique', 'perfect', or 'dead' represent an absolute state and generally do not take comparative or superlative modifiers like 'most'. | Topik: Absolute Adjectives. Kata-kata seperti 'unique', 'perfect', atau 'dead' mewakili keadaan absolut dan umumnya tidak menerima modifier komparatif atau superlatif seperti 'most'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Neither the manager nor the employees was happy with the decision.
questions.explanation: Topic: Subject-Verb Agreement with Correlative Conjunctions. With 'neither/nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it ('employees', which is plural). | Topik: Subject-Verb Agreement dengan Correlative Conjunctions. Dengan 'neither/nor', kata kerja sesuai dengan subjek yang paling dekat dengannya ('employees', yang merupakan bentuk jamak).

questions.question: The project, _______ was delayed due to funding, is now back on track.
questions.explanation: Topic: Non-defining Relative Clause. 'Which' is used for things in non-defining clauses (set off by commas). 'That' cannot be used in non-defining clauses. | Topik: Non-defining Relative Clause. 'Which' digunakan untuk benda dalam klausa non-defining (dipisahkan oleh koma). 'That' tidak dapat digunakan dalam klausa non-defining.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: She made me to clean the entire room.
questions.explanation: Topic: Causative 'Make'. Structure: make + object + base verb (without 'to'). | Topik: Causative 'Make'. Struktur: make + objek + base verb (tanpa 'to').

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: I suggest that he goes to the hospital immediately.
questions.explanation: Topic: Present Subjunctive. After verbs of suggestion like 'suggest', the base form of the verb is used, without 's' for the third person singular. | Topik: Present Subjunctive. Setelah kata kerja saran seperti 'suggest', bentuk dasar kata kerja digunakan, tanpa 's' untuk orang ketiga tunggal.

questions.passage:
Advanced Grammar Passage: Inversion and Emphasis
In formal English, inversion is often used for emphasis or stylistic effect. When a sentence begins with a negative or restrictive adverbial phrase (e.g., 'Never', 'Rarely', 'Not only', 'Under no circumstances'), the subject and the auxiliary verb are inverted, similar to question formation. For example: 'Rarely have I seen such dedication.' This structure elevates the formality and impact of the statement.
questions.question: Based on the passage, what happens when a sentence begins with 'Not only'?

options.A: The sentence becomes a direct question.
options.B: The subject and auxiliary verb are inverted.
options.C: The verb is always in the past tense.

questions.explanation: Topic: Reading Comprehension on Inversion. The passage explicitly states that negative or restrictive adverbial phrases at the beginning of a sentence trigger subject-auxiliary inversion. | Topik: Reading Comprehension on Inversion. Bacaan secara eksplisit menyatakan bahwa frasa adverbia negatif atau restriktif di awal kalimat memicu inversi subjek-kata kerja bantu.

questions.question: If she _______ more careful, she wouldn't have made that mistake.
questions.explanation: Topic: Conditional Sentence Type 3. The condition is in the past, and the result is also in the past, requiring Past Perfect in the if-clause. | Topik: Conditional Sentence Type 3. Kondisi berada di masa lalu dan hasilnya juga di masa lalu, memerlukan Past Perfect di klausa if.

questions.question: She said, 'I am reading a book.' -> She said that she _______ a book.
questions.explanation: Topic: Reported Speech (Indirect Speech). When the reporting verb is in the past ('said'), the present continuous tense in the direct speech shifts back to the past continuous tense. | Topik: Reported Speech (Kalimat Tidak Langsung). Ketika kata kerja pelapor berada di masa lalu ('said'), present continuous tense dalam kalimat langsung berubah menjadi past continuous tense.

questions.question: Not only _______ late, but he also forgot the documents.
questions.explanation: Topic: Correlative Conjunction with Inversion. 'Not only' at the beginning of a clause triggers subject-auxiliary inversion. | Topik: Correlative Conjunction dengan Inversion. 'Not only' di awal klausa memicu inversi subjek-kata kerja bantu.

questions.question: The committee _______ divided in their opinions.
questions.explanation: Topic: Subject-Verb Agreement with Collective Nouns. When a collective noun acts as individuals with different opinions, it takes a plural verb. | Topik: Subject-Verb Agreement dengan Collective Nouns. Ketika kata benda kolektif bertindak sebagai individu dengan pendapat berbeda, kata kerjanya berbentuk jamak.

questions.question: _______ the bad weather, we decided to go hiking.
questions.explanation: Topic: Prepositions of Concession. 'Despite' is a preposition followed by a noun phrase. 'Although' and 'Even though' are conjunctions followed by a full clause. | Topik: Prepositions of Concession. 'Despite' adalah preposisi yang diikuti oleh frasa kata benda. 'Although' dan 'Even though' adalah konjungsi yang diikuti oleh klausa lengkap.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: He is the man whom I think is the best candidate.
questions.explanation: Topic: Relative Pronouns in Complex Clauses. 'Who' is the subject of the verb 'is'. 'I think' is a parenthetical insertion and does not change the case of the pronoun. | Topik: Relative Pronouns dalam Complex Clauses. 'Who' adalah subjek dari kata kerja 'is'. 'I think' adalah sisipan parenthetical dan tidak mengubah kasus kata ganti.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: He asked me where did I live.
questions.explanation: Topic: Reported Question. In indirect questions, the word order changes from question order (auxiliary + subject + verb) to statement order (subject + verb). The auxiliary 'did' is removed. | Topik: Reported Question (Pertanyaan Tidak Langsung). Dalam pertanyaan tidak langsung, urutan kata berubah dari urutan pertanyaan menjadi urutan pernyataan (subjek + kata kerja). Kata bantu 'did' dihilangkan.

questions.question: The novel _______ by a famous author is a bestseller.
questions.explanation: Topic: Reduced Relative Clause. 'Written' is the past participle used to reduce the passive relative clause 'which was written'. | Topik: Reduced Relative Clause. 'Written' adalah past participle yang digunakan untuk mengurangi klausa relatif pasif 'which was written'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: I have known him since five years.
questions.explanation: Topic: Present Perfect Tense with Prepositions. 'For' is used to indicate a duration of time, while 'since' is used for a specific starting point in time. | Topik: Present Perfect Tense dengan Preposisi. 'For' digunakan untuk menunjukkan durasi waktu, sedangkan 'since' digunakan untuk titik awal waktu yang spesifik.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Despite of the heavy rain, the match continued.
questions.explanation: Topic: Conjunctions. 'Despite' is a preposition and is never followed by 'of'. 'In spite of' is the correct alternative that uses 'of'. | Topik: Conjunctions. 'Despite' adalah preposisi dan tidak pernah diikuti oleh 'of'. 'In spite of' adalah alternatif yang benar yang menggunakan 'of'.

questions.question: The scientist, _______ research won an award, is giving a lecture today.
questions.explanation: Topic: Non-defining Relative Clause with Possessive. 'Whose' is used to show possession or relationship within a relative clause. | Topik: Non-defining Relative Clause dengan Possessive. 'Whose' digunakan untuk menunjukkan kepemilikan atau hubungan dalam klausa relatif.

questions.question: He _______ be at home; I just saw him at the office.
questions.explanation: Topic: Modal of Deduction (Negative). 'Can't' is used to express a strong belief that something is impossible or not true based on evidence. | Topik: Modal of Deduction (Negatif). 'Can't' digunakan untuk menyatakan keyakinan kuat bahwa sesuatu tidak mungkin atau tidak benar berdasarkan bukti.

questions.question: The only thing _______ matters is your dedication.
questions.explanation: Topic: Relative Clauses after superlatives or 'the only'. 'That' is strongly preferred over 'which' after 'the only'. | Topik: Relative Clauses setelah superlatif atau 'the only'. 'That' sangat disukai daripada 'which' setelah 'the only'.

questions.question: The manager stated that the project _______ completed by the following week.
questions.explanation: Topic: Reported Speech with Future Tense. 'Will' shifts to 'would' when the reporting verb is in the past tense. | Topik: Reported Speech dengan Future Tense. 'Will' berubah menjadi 'would' ketika kata kerja pelapor berada dalam bentuk past tense.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: The police is investigating the robbery.
questions.explanation: Topic: Collective Nouns. 'Police' is a plural collective noun and always takes a plural verb. | Topik: Collective Nouns. 'Police' adalah kata benda kolektif jamak dan selalu menggunakan kata kerja jamak.

questions.question: It is essential that every student _______ the rules.
questions.explanation: Topic: Present Subjunctive. After 'It is essential that', the base form of the verb is used. | Topik: Present Subjunctive. Setelah 'It is essential that', bentuk dasar kata kerja digunakan.

questions.question: The book _______ I borrowed from the library is fascinating.
questions.explanation: Topic: Defining Relative Clause. 'That' or 'which' is used for things. 'That' is preferred in defining clauses. | Topik: Defining Relative Clause. 'That' atau 'which' digunakan untuk benda. 'That' lebih disukai dalam klausa yang membatasi (defining).

questions.question: By the time you arrive, we _______ dinner.
questions.explanation: Topic: Future Perfect Tense. Used to describe an action that will be completed before a specific time or another action in the future. Structure: will have + past participle. | Topik: Future Perfect Tense. Digunakan untuk menjelaskan tindakan yang akan selesai sebelum waktu tertentu atau tindakan lain di masa depan. Struktur: will have + past participle.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: You must to finish the report by Friday.
questions.explanation: Topic: Modal Verbs. Modal verbs (must, can, should, etc.) are always followed directly by the base form of the verb without 'to'. | Topik: Modal Verbs. Kata kerja modal (must, can, should, dll.) selalu diikuti langsung oleh bentuk dasar kata kerja tanpa 'to'.

questions.question: He is believed _______ the best surgeon in the country.
questions.explanation: Topic: Passive Voice with Reporting Verbs. Structure: Subject + passive reporting verb + to infinitive. | Topik: Passive Voice dengan Reporting Verbs. Struktur: Subjek + passive reporting verb + to infinitive.

questions.question: I look forward to _______ from you soon.
questions.explanation: Topic: Gerund after Prepositional Phrase. 'Look forward to' is a phrasal verb where 'to' is a preposition, so it must be followed by a gerund (V-ing). | Topik: Gerund setelah Frasa Preposisi. 'Look forward to' adalah phrasal verb di mana 'to' adalah preposisi, sehingga harus diikuti oleh gerund (V-ing).

questions.question: _______ I known about the delay, I would have taken a different flight.
questions.explanation: Topic: Inverted Conditional Type 3. 'Had I known' is the formal inversion of 'If I had known'. | Topik: Inverted Conditional Type 3. 'Had I known' adalah inversi formal dari 'If I had known'.

questions.question: I wish I _______ harder for the exam last month.
questions.explanation: Topic: Wish + Past Perfect. Used to express regret about a past situation. Structure: wish + subject + past perfect. | Topik: Wish + Past Perfect. Digunakan untuk menyatakan penyesalan tentang situasi masa lalu. Struktur: wish + subjek + past perfect.

questions.question: She denied _______ the confidential files.
questions.explanation: Topic: Gerund after specific verbs. The verb 'deny' is always followed by a gerund (V-ing). | Topik: Gerund setelah kata kerja tertentu. Kata kerja 'deny' selalu diikuti oleh gerund (V-ing).

questions.question: Under no circumstances _______ the door be left unlocked.
questions.explanation: Topic: Negative Inversion. 'Under no circumstances' at the beginning of a sentence triggers subject-auxiliary inversion. | Topik: Negative Inversion. 'Under no circumstances' di awal kalimat memicu inversi subjek-kata kerja bantu.

questions.question: Had I known about the traffic, I _______ a different route.
questions.explanation: Topic: Inverted Conditional Type 3. 'Had I known' is the inverted form of 'If I had known'. The main clause requires 'would have + past participle'. | Topik: Inverted Conditional Type 3. 'Had I known' adalah bentuk inversi dari 'If I had known'. Klausa utama memerlukan 'would have + past participle'.

questions.question: She asked me _______ I could help her with the project.
questions.explanation: Topic: Reported Yes/No Questions. 'If' or 'whether' is used to report a yes/no question in indirect speech. | Topik: Reported Yes/No Questions. 'If' atau 'whether' digunakan untuk melaporkan pertanyaan ya/tidak dalam kalimat tidak langsung.

questions.question: _______ he is wealthy, he is not happy.
questions.explanation: Topic: Conjunctions of Concession. 'Although' introduces a subordinate clause (subject + verb). 'Despite' and 'In spite of' require a noun phrase. | Topik: Conjunctions of Concession. 'Although' memperkenalkan klausa bawahan (subjek + kata kerja). 'Despite' dan 'In spite of' memerlukan frasa kata benda.

questions.question: You had better _______ a doctor immediately.
questions.explanation: Topic: Had better + Base Verb. 'Had better' functions as a modal idiom and is always followed by the base form of the verb without 'to'. | Topik: Had better + Base Verb. 'Had better' berfungsi sebagai idiom modal dan selalu diikuti oleh bentuk dasar kata kerja tanpa 'to'.

questions.question: The streets are wet. It _______ rained last night.
questions.explanation: Topic: Modal of Deduction (Past). 'Must have + past participle' is used to make a logical conclusion about a past event. | Topik: Modal of Deduction (Masa Lampau). 'Must have + past participle' digunakan untuk membuat kesimpulan logis tentang peristiwa masa lalu.

questions.question: The doctor recommended that he _______ more water.
questions.explanation: Topic: Present Subjunctive. After verbs of suggestion, demand, or recommendation (recommend, suggest, insist), the base form of the verb is used in the 'that' clause. | Topik: Present Subjunctive. Setelah kata kerja saran, tuntutan, atau rekomendasi (recommend, suggest, insist), bentuk dasar kata kerja digunakan dalam klausa 'that'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: She avoided to answer the difficult question.
questions.explanation: Topic: Verbs followed by Gerunds. The verb 'avoid' is always followed by a gerund (V-ing), not an infinitive. | Topik: Kata Kerja yang diikuti Gerund. Kata kerja 'avoid' selalu diikuti oleh gerund (V-ing), bukan infinitive.

questions.question: If he _______ taller, he would join the basketball team.
questions.explanation: Topic: Conditional Sentence Type 2. In formal English, 'were' is used for all subjects (including I, he, she, it) in the if-clause of a Type 2 conditional. | Topik: Conditional Sentence Type 2. Dalam bahasa Inggris formal, 'were' digunakan untuk semua subjek (termasuk I, he, she, it) di klausa if dari conditional type 2.

questions.question: She _______ for the company for ten years before she got promoted.
questions.explanation: Topic: Past Perfect Continuous Tense. Emphasizes the duration of an action that was ongoing up until another point in the past. | Topik: Past Perfect Continuous Tense. Menekankan durasi suatu tindakan yang sedang berlangsung hingga titik tertentu di masa lalu.

questions.question: If I had known about the meeting, I _______ attended it.
questions.explanation: Topic: Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Past Unreal). It describes an impossible past condition and its probable past result. Structure: If + Past Perfect, would have + Past Participle. | Topik: Conditional Sentence Type 3 (Pengandaian Masa Lampau). Menjelaskan kondisi masa lalu yang tidak mungkin terjadi dan hasil probabelnya di masa lalu. Struktur: If + Past Perfect, would have + Past Participle.

questions.question: He speaks as if he _______ the manager, but he is just an intern.
questions.explanation: Topic: Subjunctive with 'as if'. Used to describe an unreal or hypothetical situation in the present. 'Were' is preferred over 'was' for all subjects. | Topik: Subjunctive dengan 'as if'. Digunakan untuk menggambarkan situasi yang tidak nyata atau hipotetis di masa kini. 'Were' lebih disukai daripada 'was' untuk semua subjek.

questions.question: If only I _______ that I was being watched.
questions.explanation: Topic: If only + Past Perfect. Used to express strong regret about a past event. | Topik: If only + Past Perfect. Digunakan untuk menyatakan penyesalan yang kuat tentang peristiwa masa lalu.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: If I would have time, I will help you tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Topic: Conditional Sentence Type 1. The 'if' clause must use the Simple Present tense, not 'would'. Structure: If + Simple Present, will + base verb. | Topik: Conditional Sentence Type 1. Klausa 'if' harus menggunakan Simple Present tense, bukan 'would'. Struktur: If + Simple Present, will + base verb.

questions.question: You _______ have seen him; he is currently on vacation in Bali.
questions.explanation: Topic: Modal of Deduction (Past Negative). 'Can't have + past participle' expresses certainty that something did not happen in the past. | Topik: Modal of Deduction (Past Negative). 'Can't have + past participle' menyatakan kepastian bahwa sesuatu tidak terjadi di masa lalu.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: I would rather you don't smoke inside the house.
questions.explanation: Topic: Would rather + Subject + Past Tense. When the subject of 'would rather' is different from the subject of the following clause, the past tense is used to express a present preference. | Topik: Would rather + Subjek + Past Tense. Ketika subjek 'would rather' berbeda dengan subjek klausa berikutnya, past tense digunakan untuk menyatakan preferensi masa kini.
